name: Thorvald Deepforge
summary: At the Valley of Kings, travelers bound for Loch Modan find Thorvald Deepforge ready with weapons. He helps defend the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

sections.title: Arming the Eastern Pass
sections.body: Thorvald Deepforge supplies weapons at the Valley of Kings. Troggs and roaming wildlife threaten the mountain passes between Khaz Modan's heartland and its outlying lands. Travelers from Dun Morogh and those bound deeper into Loch Modan can find blades and axes here, ready to defend dwarven lands.

faq.answer: Thorvald Deepforge sells weapons at the Valley of Kings, where the road leaves Dun Morogh for Loch Modan. He supplies travelers and defenders along the border.

faq.q: What role does he play in the region's defense?
faq.answer: Thorvald Deepforge supplies weapons to travelers crossing the mountain passes. He also helps arm recruits bound for outposts across Loch Modan.

faq.q: Is he related to the other Deepforges in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Thorvald Deepforge may be related to other dwarves who share the Deepforge name, including Murgot and Bengus Deepforge, but no family tie is confirmed. Tormus Deepforge of the Great Forge calls Thorvald his colleague.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you find Thorvald beneath the ancestral monoliths of the Valley of Kings, helping keep Khaz Modan's borders supplied and secure.
As a blacksmith, you know the Deepforge name and the reliable iron goods dwarven smiths are known for.
